purpose: Learn a compact row-local correction to the frozen V3 M3 anchor from strictly earlier-season OOF errors, using hierarchical current-season state rather than same-fold labels.

protocol.anchor: v3_sparse_m3_frozen with exactly reconstructed 2020 and 2021 OOF panels
protocol.fit_rule_for_fold_y: fit only R rows from available V3 OOF panels with 2020 <= season < Y
protocol.target: (control_success - V3_anchor) centered to zero separately inside each historical OOF season
protocol.application_route: apply the correction only to R rows; retain V3 exactly on F rows
protocol.future_safe_state: official as-of counters minus constants frozen before the row season

selection_rule.primary: maximum 2022 R competition-score gain over V3
selection_rule.eligibility: positive point gain and positive pitcher-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound
selection_rule.if_no_candidate_is_eligible: close this experiment as failed without opening 2023 or 2024 for configuration selection

post_selection_rule.2023: transfer audit only; no parameter or route change
post_selection_rule.2024: confirmation only after the selection artifact is written
post_selection_rule.completion: subject to EXPERIMENT_PLAN_V5 conservative lower-bound and package gates
